parsed.rationale: One copy of `DebugMetricsProvider.init` is the canonical definition in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). The duplicate resides in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` path segment identifies this as a sample-app context regardless of the pipeline's `is_sample_app: false` flag. Sample apps routinely inline or re-implement lightweight debug helpers to remain self-contained and avoid pulling in the full `DebugPanel` dependency graph. Merging them would couple the example app to the library in a way that defeats its illustrative purpose.
